name: Armed Detective Agency
description: They are a group focused on solving crimes which are considered too violent or difficult for the metropolitan police to handle. Often, these crimes are of a supernatural origin. Nearly all of the detectives within the company have their own special powers known as abilities. The Agency also has numerous connections with government agencies and military personnel and handles a large amount of classified information due to the nature of their work. The Agency's licensed staff possess police-like authority and may carry weapons under certain conditions. They can also access police records, giving them considerable investigative freedom, including the ability to interfere with official investigations, falsify information, wiretap communications, and secretly monitor important facilities.
admission: The Agency has an entrance exam for new employees, to assess if they possess qualities that make them worthy to join the Agency. The test usually consists of their qualities as a detective and their emotions of whether they are willing to risk their lives to save people. In order to join the Agency, the candidate must take a test that evaluates their righteousness, prowess, wisdom, morality and genuineness of spirit. The test supervisor watches the entrant's moves and determines whether they are a good fit to the Agency.

name: Port Mafia
description: The Port Mafia is a criminal organization that operates in Yokohama. They are known for their ruthlessness and are involved in various illegal activities, including smuggling, extortion, and assassination. The organization is led by a mysterious figure known as the Boss, who maintains strict control over its members. The Port Mafia has a reputation for being highly organized and efficient, making them a formidable force in the criminal underworld.

name: Special Division for Unusual Powers
description: The Special Division for Unusual Powers is a secret service under the Ministry of Home Affairs, which is in charge of maintaining national security regarding Ability-related cases by monitoring and regulating gifted individuals and organizations throughout Japan. In times of activities caused by criminal entities, the Special Division manages such incidents through supervising the concerned parties and through cover-ups to prevent the public from learning about the ability-related cases as much as possible. Though the general approach of the Special Division is to not terminate hostile ability users, they may nonetheless dispose them if deemed necessary.

name: Mimic
description: Mimic was a guerrilla organization from Europe that escaped to Japan after committing a war crime sometime during a past global war. Led by André Gide, Mimic intended to find someone to kill them as soldiers as one last bit of solace after facing disgrace and shame.

name: Metropolitan Police
description: The Metropolitan Police are Yokohama's primary law-enforcement force. Their main responsibility is protecting the city and maintaining public security. Many police officers are also known to hold qualifications in kendo and jujutsu.

name: V
description: V is a domestic gifted underground syndicate that operates in Japan, whose goal is to rid the country of ability users. According to then assassin Sakunosuke Oda, the group kills for justice and, once finished doing so, shall only continue to kill indiscriminately.

name: Ministry of Justice
description: The Ministry of Justice is a government ministry responsible for legal and judicial affairs in Japan.

name: The Guild
description: The Guild is an international organization of highly skilled individuals who specialize in various forms of combat, espionage, and intelligence gathering. They operate globally and are known for their advanced technology and strategic operations. The Guild often takes on high-risk missions that require precision and expertise, making them a respected and feared entity in the world of covert operations.

name: The Renewed Guild
description: The Renewed Guild is the reestablished form of the original Guild, created by Francis Scott Key Fitzgerald after recovering from the organization's defeat. With only Francis and Louisa May Alcott as its known members, it represents the Guild's continued legacy and ambitions.

name: Surviving Guild Forces
description: The Guild split into two different groups, the Guild itself led by Fitzgerald and the Surviving Guild Forces led by Steinbeck. Since Steinbeck is looking for revenge against Fitzgerald, the groups are opposed to each other.

name: Café Uzumaki
description: Café Uzumaki is a café in Yokohama. It is located on the first floor of the building where the agency office is. This is where the Agency members sometimes hang out during their free time.

name: Rats in the House of the Dead
description: The Rats in the House of the Dead are a clandestine criminal organization led by Fyodor Dostoevsky. Operating from the shadows through deception, manipulation, and carefully orchestrated schemes, the group seeks to reshape the world according to Fyodor's ideals and has become one of the most dangerous threats faced by ability users.

name: Order of the Clock Tower
description: The Order of the Clock Tower is a British state organization composed of powerful ability users. Serving as a secret military agency and knightly order, it holds the authority to protect the Queen. Its members include some of the Queen's highest-ranking imperial guards and are said to rival the Transcendents in power.

name: Decay of the Angel
description: The Decay of the Angel is a terrorist organization operating in secret within Japan. Possessing a page from the Book, its members orchestrate large-scale acts of terrorism, deception, and political manipulation in pursuit of their own vision of justice and societal change. Their actions make them one of the greatest threats faced by both the Armed Detective Agency and the government.

name: Hunting Dogs
description: The Hunting Dogs are a group of mercenaries who specialize in tracking and eliminating targets. They are known for their relentless pursuit and efficiency in completing contracts.

name: Sky Casino
description: The Sky Casino is a floating casino owned by Sigma. It is a high-altitude floating establishment built right after the war ended. It has helium and the centrifugal force from the mass balancer makes it possible to stay aloft with far less fuel than it appears to need. It is a de facto free state which indicates it is outside of the jurisdiction of any nation under international law.

name: Shin-Tsuruya Institute
description: An educational institution attended by Doppo Kunikida prior to joining the Armed Detective Agency.

name: 356th Infantry Division
description: The 356th Infantry Division was a military unit of the Great War. It is best known for the battlefield where Akiko Yosano served as a military physician, an experience that profoundly shaped her ideals and the development of her ability.

name: Transcendents
description: The Transcendents is a certain group of a few dozen ability users sent by the nations of Europe to the war. Very little is known about the organization of the Transcendents, how they stand out, what specific tasks they perform, or what influence they have. But its members are on the same level as those of the Order of the Clock Tower. The only known members belong to different nationalities: France, England, and Germany, respectively. Furthermore, its members are presumed to be powerful ability users.

name: May Uprising
description: The May Uprising is a rebel force group with only one member - their leader, named Pan, an ability user. They have fought the DGSS Operations Division at an unknown point in time.

name: DGSS
description: The DGSS is an intelligence agency whose Operations Division was involved in suppressing armed threats and conducting covert operations. It is known to have fought the May Uprising at an unknown point in time. Little is known about the organization.

name: Sheep
description: The Sheep was a group consisting largely of teenagers who maintained their own territory and came into conflict with the Port Mafia and other organizations.

name: The Seven Traitors
description: The Seven Traitors is an organization of criminals who ended the war among nations. They were seven individuals, each from a different country and of a different race. What they had in common was their extraordinary abilities and a firm resolution to end the war, regardless of how dirty their hands got even if it meant ignoring all principles and morals.

name: Zoopark
description: Zoopark is a criminal organization made up of wanted criminals. Its leader, Thumbnail, is known for eponymously pulling out the thumbnail of his victims. They move their hideout every four days, making them difficult for even international law enforcement to locate.

name: Manhasset Security
description: Manhasset Security is a security company in Yokohama. The company was formerly headed by Tom Buchanan until his arrest for framing his employee, T. J. Eckleburg, for murder. The company's headquarters is located across the Port Mafia Base. It has blue-colored building walls and is home to Eckleburg's creation and ID system, the Eyes of God.

name: S&K Corporation
description: S&K Corporation was a company based in Yokohama. It was led by one of Yukichi Fukuzawa's clients from a regular contract deal until her assassination some time after the war.

name: Japanese Government
description: The Japanese Government is the national governing authority of Japan. Various organizations and individuals, including ability users, operate under its authority throughout the series.

name: Band of Thieves
description: The Band of Thieves is a criminal group led by Nemo. Its members operate as professional thieves and attempted to steal a valuable treasure on Standard Island.

name: Europole
description: Europole is a law enforcement agency based in Europe that handles criminal intelligence and combats crime and terrorism through the cooperation of its member states.

name: Research Facility A
description: Research Facility A was a secret military facility in the Yokohama Settlement in Japan, which researched artificial abilities. After the facility and its surrounding area were destroyed eight years prior to the Arahabaki Incident, the explosion's aftermath became Suribachi City, named after its mortar shape like that of a suribachi.

name: Research Facility B
description: Research Facility B is a secret military facility in Japan, which researched artificial abilities. It was modeled after Research Facility A, which was destroyed in a massive explosion.

name: Ayatsuji Detective Agency
description: Ayatsuji Detective Agency is a detective agency run by Yukito Ayatsuji.
